spec_match.rationale: Probes typeof/arity/descriptor of the exact method and runs a real call on a connecting-then-failed session, matching the spec's abort-to-InvalidStateError step.

interactive.rationale: Descriptor table fills on load; one button constructs a real failing session, calls the method, and timestamps every step.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the exact-member probe plus the real rejection path; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers method-missing, synchronous-throw (flagged as out-of-contract), unexpected-resolve, and the expected InvalidStateError branches.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the exact spec anchor in see-also.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite pins arity, Promise return, three RangeError gates, the >=4096 ceiling floor, and failed-session InvalidStateError; verified executing (8 fail on this build, honest).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chromium 141 (predates Chrome 158, feature absent even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features) via Playwright 1.56 at desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, driving every control; screenshots under /tmp/claude-0/agentB/shots/. Steps log showed the session constructed and the honest 'method missing' stop; the InvalidStateError rejection itself needs a 158 build.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the primary contract and the explicit fallback branch; console output is intentional and prefixed.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css; buttons overriding background also set color; AA pairs (text-charcoal/bg-stone, bg-ivory/text-black, accent-emerald-dark on paper).

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, visible focus (verified first-Tab), caption+scope tables, aria-live polite result regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports clean; kv grid collapses to one column under 480px.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify the supported path on a real Chrome 158 / Canary build
openQuestions.detail: This environment's Chromium 141 lacks the surface even behind --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, so only the honest-absent branch ran. On Chrome 158 (or Canary with the feature's runtime flag) verify: that the returned promise rejects with InvalidStateError when the session fails, and the declared arity is 3.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Landmarks, native semantics, accessible names, visible focus, and polite live regions for asynchronous state changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Content sits in main/header/footer landmarks; async results land in aria-live=polite output/status elements; tables carry caption plus th scope=col; first-Tab focus visibility verified in the browser.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsically-sized grid/flex layouts (auto-fit + minmax) so panels reflow without horizontal overflow at narrow widths.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control panels use grid-template-columns repeat(auto-fit, minmax()), tables are wrapped in overflow-x containers, and long tokens use overflow-wrap: anywhere; verified no horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce error/failure outcomes programmatically, not only visually.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Real API errors (name + message) are written into aria-live output regions and colour is never the only signal (text states the outcome).

summary: Exact-surface probe with a real failing-session rejection path; honest-absent branch verified.
